structuralQcRuntimeFailure.exceptionMessage: Object of type bool_ is not JSON serializable

provenRootCause.sourcePattern: len(times) >= 2 and len(times) == len(steps) and np.all(np.isfinite(times)) and np.all(np.isfinite(steps)) and np.all(np.diff(times) > 0.0) and np.all(np.diff(steps) == 4.0)
provenRootCause.whyItLeaks: numpy.all returns numpy.bool_. Python boolean `and` returns the last evaluated operand rather than coercing it to native bool. When every frozen-grid condition is true, the final np.all(...) result is stored directly in checks['frozenGrid'] as numpy.bool_. The later pass aggregation explicitly calls bool(value), so validation control flow succeeds, but the raw checks dictionary is inserted into the receipt and json.dumps rejects numpy.bool_.

successorImplementationRequirement.requiredRepair: Ensure every independent-QC receipt value is JSON-native before serialization. At minimum coerce checks['frozenGrid'] to native bool. Prefer a generic deterministic JSON-safety normalization that converts numpy.generic scalars via .item(), arrays via .tolist() with recursive normalization, and preserves native dict/list/string/int/float/bool/null values.
successorImplementationRequirement.requiredStaticTest: Construct a synthetic QC receipt containing numpy.bool_, numpy integer/float scalars, and a small ndarray; normalize it; assert json.dumps succeeds and booleans remain native bool. Also assert the structural checks dictionary contains only native bool values before receipt serialization.
